notes: Approach 1 (pure SLC/SAS PROC SQL) from the repo's market-basket example: for each customer who bought butter, count co-purchased products, keep the top 5, and compute each product's probability relative to the butter count. Substituted the external sd1.market sas7bdat library (libname sd1 sas7bdat 'd:/sd1') with an inline datalines work.market of the same (id, products) shape, and declared the top-5 cap as PROC SQL OUTOBS=5. Correlated subquery, GROUP BY/ORDER BY, and the retain/prob DATA step are verbatim upstream.
